name: TRELLIS
paper_title: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
license_interpretation: MIT is a permissive license, so the code and weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products; the only obligation is to keep the copyright and license notice with copies. LibreYOLO's adapter is MIT, and the flow models, decoders, sparse modules and sampler it adapts from TRELLIS keep MIT, noted in libreyolo/models/gen/trellis/NOTICE. LibreYOLO replaces upstream's CUDA-only spconv, xformers and flash-attn calls with PyTorch, and does not use TRELLIS's Gaussian holder, which carries Inria's non-commercial Gaussian Splatting license. The microsoft/TRELLIS-image-large weights (MIT) are redistributed unchanged as LibreYOLO/LibreTRELLISl together with the BiRefNet weights (MIT); the DINOv2 image encoder, facebook/dinov2-with-registers-large (Apache-2.0), downloads from Meta. All are pinned and none is gated.
